title: Premixed Versus Manually Mixed Calcium Silicate-based Bioceramic Materials for Pulpotomy of Permanent Teeth with Irreversible Pulpitis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
html: Calcium silicate-based bioceramic materials are widely used in vital pulp therapy because of their favorable biological and sealing properties. Premixed formulations were introduced to reduce operator-dependent variability associated with manually mixed materials; however, their comparative clinical performance in irreversible pulpitis remains unclear.
